description: Systems are not configured to detect or alert on security-relevant events such as attacks, unauthorized access attempts, or anomalous behavior. This signal indicates that security incidents may occur without detection.
applicability: Applicable to all systems and networks requiring security monitoring. Includes intrusion detection systems, security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, and network traffic analysis.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of monitoring tool deployment, SIEM coverage, IDS/IPS configurations, and alerting rule effectiveness.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Information Integrity
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
